source.container: The Science of Making Torque from Wind Conference 2026
source.notes:
In this key-note presentation at the TORQUE2026 conference, I talked about how open innovation and data sharing can advance wind energy innovation, in particular related to Structural Health Monitoring. I talked about:

(1) Digitalisation is about creating value from data.

(2) Through interviews with practitioners, we found that key needs are introducing common vocabulary and data models, fostering a digital organisational culture and digital skills, and providing platforms or opportunities to innovate together.

(3) The WeDoWind open innovation ecosystem attempts to address these needs by providing a platform to share data and code, and to work on common vocabularies and recommendations for sharing data, and to solve data-related industry problems collaboratively.
source.title: How open innovation and data sharing can advance Structural Health Monitoring in wind energy
